subject: POC coordination: playbook, owners, success criteria, and exec readout cadence
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@healthgrid.com>, Martin Cruz <martin.cruz@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Recap + next steps — POC scope & draft success criteria

Hi Emily / Martin,

Thanks again for taking the call this morning — really appreciated the clarity around the workflows you want to accelerate. Per our conversation, I wanted to capture the proposed POC playbook and the immediate next steps so we can lock ownership and schedule the exec readout.

Quick recap (agreed in call):
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for HealthGrid clinical summarization pipeline (reduce triage time for care coordinators).
- Duration: 4 weeks (3-week trial + 1 week for stabilizing and runout).
- Success criteria (draft):
  * Relevance: >= 80% top-3 precision on the curated 250-case sample set
  * Latency: P95 < 350ms average across sample queries (within your dev region)
  * Reliability: < 2% error rate across 2k internal calls during trial
- Owners: HealthGrid: Emily (PM), Martin (Tech lead). Redwood: Laura (AE, overall), Marissa (Solutions engineer).

Action items I captured:
1) HealthGrid to share the 250-case sample set + a short note on acceptance labeling by EOD Friday (Dec 3).
2) Redwood to deliver a POC runbook and setup guide by Monday (Dec 6).
3) Schedule exec readout (10–20 minute briefing + Q&A) for week of Dec 20 — decision window open until Dec 23.
4) Procurement contact to be looped in once the readout is scheduled so we can fast-track SOW.

I've attached a v1 of the POC playbook for your review (Redwood_POC_playbook_v1.pdf). Please mark any edits inline; once you confirm owners and the sample dataset we'll provision a private trial environment and baseline metrics.

Are you comfortable with the draft success criteria above? If you want to tighten the latency or change the evaluation metric (e.g., top-1 vs top-3), let me know and we can update the runbook.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_POC_playbook_v1.pdf (21KB)

From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@healthgrid.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Martin Cruz <martin.cruz@healthgrid.com>, procurement@healthgrid.com
Date: 2026-11-29T13:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps — POC scope & draft success criteria

Thanks Laura — that matches my notes nicely. A few quick clarifications and one ask from procurement.

Clarifications/edits:
- Relevance metric: can we run both top-1 and top-3? For exec we prefer top-3 to show recall, but our clinical reviewers will want top-1 precision as a gate — proposed pass: top-3 >= 80% AND top-1 >= 62%.
- Latency: 350ms P95 is ideal; if that requires a quantized variant that's fine as long as quality stays within the thresholds above.
- Data retention / security: we need confirmation that logs/inputs from the trial will be retained for no more than 30 days and that the VPC option is available for staging.

Procurement note (cc'd): procurement@healthgrid.com — we'll need a high-level SOW and an estimated monthly commitment for dedicated capacity if we move to production. Can you include a short table of estimated token spend for the trial so procurement can budget?

Availability for exec readout: week of Dec 20 works; prefer Dec 22 or 23 morning PST.

I attached a short spreadsheet with our sample-case metadata (HealthGrid_POC_req.xlsx). Martin will follow up with the technical appendix.

—Emily
Emily Zhao
Product Lead, HealthGrid
emily.zhao@healthgrid.com

Attachments: HealthGrid_POC_req.xlsx (43KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@healthgrid.com>, Martin Cruz <martin.cruz@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps — POC scope & draft success criteria

Perfect — thanks Emily. Confirming updates and next steps below (collated).

Confirmed success criteria (final draft for runbook):
- Top-3 precision >= 80% AND Top-1 precision >= 62% on the 250-case sample set labelled by HealthGrid clinical reviewers.
- Latency: P95 < 350ms in HealthGrid staging region (we'll run a baseline synthetic pass first).
- Reliability: < 2% failed responses across a 2k-call smoke run and a daily-run for the trial window.

Redwood deliverables by Dec 6:
- Final POC runbook with test harness and evaluation checklist (Ops-Runbook-HG.docx).
- Baseline throughput/latency report from our staging environment (initial synthetic pass).
- Token spend estimate for the trial (for procurement table).

HealthGrid deliverables by Dec 3:
- 250-case sample set + acceptance labels (HealthGrid_POC_req.xlsx).
- Confirmed procurement contact and any contract constraints.

Exec readout scheduling: proposing Dec 22, 10:00–10:25 AM PT. That gives us time to run the two-week mid-trial checkpoint (Dec 13) and final stabilization (Dec 20–21). If that works for your execs we'll send a calendar invite and a short 2-slide readout template for the panel.

I'll attach the ops runbook draft for internal review — Marissa, Jonas: can you both scan the runbook and flag any infra/ops items that need headroom (e.g., dedicated vCPU/GPU, monitoring hooks, fallback model plan)? I'll incorporate and send the calendar invite once Emily confirms the slot.

Thanks — Laura

---
Attachments: Ops-Runbook-HG.docx (28KB)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T08:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Ops-Runbook-HG.docx — infra check and exec brief input

Thanks Laura — quick notes after skimming the runbook:
- Infrastructure: we'll need to provision a small dedicated pool (2x A10-level GPUs) for the baseline runs to get realistic P95 latency numbers; otherwise cloud-burst tests won't match production estimates.
- Monitoring: include token-level tracing and a lightweight eval hook that samples 5% of responses for immediate quality reporting.
- Fallback policy: recommend we configure an automatic fallback to a smaller-quantized variant if P95 breaches 600ms during heavy test runs — call this out in the readout as the "graceful degradation" plan.

Exec brief: I'll prepare a 2-slide summary that covers: trial scope & owners, risk & mitigation (incl. fallback plan), expected economics (token spend estimate), and a 5-minute demo script. I can be on the readout deck Dec 22 10:00 AM PT. Marissa — can you validate the token spend numbers?

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@healthgrid.com>, Martin Cruz <martin.cruz@healthgrid.com>, procurement@healthgrid.com
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T14:02:00-08:00
Subject: Confirmed: Dec 22 exec readout + prep checklist (SOW next steps)

Emily / Martin / Procurement team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Dec 22, 10:00–10:25 AM PT is confirmed for the exec readout. Calendar invite and the 2-slide readout template are live (link below).

Prep checklist for the readout (what we'll deliver):
- Short baseline run: synthetic P95 latency report + sample traces (Redwood).
- Live sample evaluation: top-1 / top-3 precision summary on your 250-case set (HealthGrid + Redwood).
- Demo script: 5-minute guided demo (Jonas + Martin).
- Decision rubric for exec: pass = both quality thresholds met AND latency target met; fail = otherwise. If the rubric is pass, next step is procurement + SOW signature; if marginal (one metric within 5%), we recommend a 2-week extension to tune quantization/ops.

Links / artifacts:
- Readout template + calendar: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPOCfolder
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890
- Draft SOW (for procurement review): https://app.docusign.com/some-doc-link

Marissa — can you upload the token-spend estimate and SOW stub to the Drive folder by EOD today? Procurement — let us know any contractual items we should pre-clear before the readout.

Thanks all — looking forward to the session. If any of the execs need a pre-brief, we can arrange a 15-minute sync the week prior (Dec 15–17).

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
